measurement: Why 91% of quoted contract value is unservable: the three T2 routes
context: The financial certification found every large ($1,200) and premium ($3,500) contract refused for want of T2_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW -- $117,500 of $129,375 quoted. That report called the ceiling 'unlockable' without testing it. This tests it.

route_1_owner_review.requirement: a cryptographically signed approval naming the artifact digest
route_1_owner_review.blocked_by: SOLVENT_OWNER_KEY unset: 'owner review: unavailable (no owner signing key)'

and_when_the_key_IS_set.measured: delivery is then refused for every job, T1 included
and_when_the_key_IS_set.exact_refusal: action gate refused delivery: C2_EXTERNAL_COMMUNICATION exceeds any preauthorization and an Owner Channel is configured, so approvals must be signed by it
and_when_the_key_IS_set.cause: harness.py mints an UNSIGNED gate.approval() for delivery; no production path mints a SignedApproval for it
and_when_the_key_IS_set.baseline_effect: 100 contracts delivered 0 with the key set, versus 43 without it
and_when_the_key_IS_set.test_coverage: no existing test runs a full business cycle with an owner signing key configured

route_2_differential_review_csv.requirement: an independently authored reader for the deliverable's format
route_2_differential_review_csv.exact_refusal: differential review (csv): unavailable (no independently authored reader for .csv is known to this build, so a second automated opinion would be Solvent reading its own output twice)
route_2_differential_review_csv.verdict: BLOCKED - the reader does not exist

route_3_differential_review_xlsx.measured_refusal: the independent reader disagrees with the deliverable: Client ref values all came from the source: 3 value(s) the source never had
route_3_differential_review_xlsx.verdict: FALSE POSITIVE in the reviewer, not fabrication by the worker
route_3_differential_review_xlsx.defect: independent.py's provenance check reads only the first sheet of the source workbook, so a correctly consolidated output is flagged as inventing values. It blocks every T2-tier spreadsheet job that uses consolidate_sheets.
route_3_differential_review_xlsx.what_was_NOT_found: The worker did not invent data. Every value it emitted came from a source sheet.

financial_consequence.note: All three T2 routes are blocked, each for a different reason, which is why no large or premium contract completed.

not_done: No production file was modified. These are documented for owner approval, per this round's execution authority.
